versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation with a clearer overview of generated content formats and usage instructions.
- Expanded list of content outputs the skill can create from a single source.
- Added details on tone customization for platform-optimized content.
- Included API usage and requirements section for easier integration.
- Stated process for purchasing credits if the API quota is exceeded.

- Added a new "DeFi Research" section, highlighting an additional available skill for token pricing, DEX liquidity checks, and gas price tracking for crypto traders.
- No core functionality changes to Content Multiply Pro; informational update only.
Integrated Business Intel API - pay per lookup via Stripe

Initial release of Content Multiply Pro.

- Instantly converts a single blog post, video, or podcast into 15+ content formats.
- Supports major platforms: Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit, Quora, Medium, newsletters, and more.
- Adapts content style to each platform automatically.
- Offers tone customization options: professional, casual, humorous, authoritative, or educational.
- Requires only a web-connected OpenClaw agent; no extra API keys needed.
